name: The policy, end to end
caption: Each observed frame becomes one joint state–action token. One causal context Transformer reads them; its state for the current frame is handed to one causal action decoder, which writes the next controller frames in order. The first two are played, the rest are replaced by the next plan. Select a stage to open it.

name: Where a predicted action may look
caption: Three decoder generations in one notation. Next-frame prediction writes one frame from the trunk state. Independent multi-token prediction writes several at once from the trunk state alone. The autoregressive decoder writes them in order, each handed the frames before it — the same rule that orders the controller groups inside a frame.

name: Three paths into the action logits
caption: O43 arm A feeds the action logits three ways: the temporal decoder’s future-frame state, conditioned within the frame by FiLM and read by a SiLU MLP head, plus a direct skip from the trunk state. Removing any one of them cost stocks on both evaluation suites; hover a row to see the path it removed.

name: Run-length action spans
caption: O18 packed the four controller groups into one symbol per frame and let BPE merge repeated holds into span tokens of up to 16 frames. The compression was real; executing a token to completion was not, and the package lost 2.6 stocks per minute.
